title: KanjiEntry
description: A single kanji entry in the Japanese-learning knowledge base (kanji-master.json).

kanji.description: The single kanji character this entry describes.

meaning_primary.description: The single most important English meaning / keyword, e.g. 'eat / food'.

on_yomi.description: On-readings in katakana (canonical dictionary form), e.g. ['ショク', 'ジキ'].

kun_yomi.description: Kun-readings in hiragana with okurigana dot notation, e.g. ['た.べる'].

stroke_count.description: Number of strokes for this kanji.

radicals.description: Component radicals used to build the mnemonic (kanji characters or descriptive labels).

mnemonic.description: A short, memorable English story linking the radicals to the meaning.

vocab_using.description: IDs of vocab entries (from vocab/schema.json) that use this kanji. References tier CSV slugs.

kanji.description: The sentence in normal kanji+kana orthography.

kana.description: The sentence written fully in kana.

module_introduced.description: Module number (0–12) in which this kanji is first introduced.

notes.description: Freeform note: common reading confusions, historical context, etc. null if unused.
